entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Yeah, this VeloBand you sold me is a piece of junk. It's not working and I want my money back immediately.

I'm very sorry to hear you're having trouble with your device. I can certainly look into this for you. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?
Are you kidding me? It's a technical fault! The thing is completely broken. It won't sync with my phone, no matter what I do. It's a defective product and I've wasted enough time on it.
I understand your frustration. It sounds like a syncing problem, which we might be able to resolve. Have you tried...

I'm not trying anything! I'm not your tech support. I paid for a working product and I got a defective one. This is unacceptable. I want a return label and a full refund. Now. Or you can get me your manager and I'll explain it to them while I write a review about your garbage products.
Okay, there's no need for that, sir. I can definitely check on the return eligibility for you. I just need to pull up your account. One moment please.
Alright, I see your order here. It looks like the VeloBand was delivered about 36 days ago. Let me just confirm our policy...
Okay, yes. According to our policy, you have 10 days from the delivery date for a return. You're unfortunately outside that timeframe, so I can go ahead and process that for you. No problem at all.
Oh. So, you'll just take it back? Full refund?

Yes, absolutely. I'm generating a prepaid return label for you right now. You'll receive it in your email within the next 10 minutes. Just package the band, apply the label, and drop it in the mail. Once we receive the defective unit, we will issue a full refund to your original payment method.
Fine. That's all I wanted. Should have just done that from the start.
I apologize for the inconvenience. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
